**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The fix is one tie-break line in `crates/app/src/operation/tool_gate.rs:127` (`.then_with(|| na.cmp(nb))`). Name order is byte order: deterministic on every platform and independent of the catalog's file order. I checked it against the catalog: 'BN-0600', 'EM-0600-4FL' and 'CM-0600-90' each sort below their 'Router ...' rivals, and the 6.35 mm (1/4 in) entries lose on distance first. The cause story matches #3159.
- The pin `a_size_tie_picks_by_name_not_file_order` (`crates/app/tests/tool_gate.rs:249`) covers both orders of the ball-nose pair, and the catalog plus the reversed catalog for ball-nose, end mill and taper. That answers the taper risk named in the body.
- `the_refusal_names_a_fitting_catalog_entry` is unchanged (diff context line 198; no assert is weakened anywhere in the diff — the test diff only adds the new pin).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests in the diff. The `catalog_tool` helper's `expect` is in the test file, which is allowed.
- The tie-break decision is recorded in `docs/decisions/3170-catalog-hint-tie-by-name.md`, with what was dropped and why. Law satisfied.
- Placement, provenance, Gate map, body (`Fixes #3170`, `Changelog: none`), conventional commit subject: all fine. No process files, no goldens, no snapshot PNGs, no new dependencies. Both files stay under 400 lines.

## Results

Ran on the self-hosted runner (macOS, label camcraft-pr-test): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/44916710392 — head verified as the one reviewed, trial merge with main `60cb97a0b` clean (`merged: true`), GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate on the merged tree | ok — 8 steps, 0 failed |
| app build (--no-run) | ok 128s |
| app lib, thread_mill, tool_after_state, tool_body_beside_shank, tool_gate, wire_contour, wire_tool | ok (the gate map resolved the src change to these 6 suites; `tool_gate` ran whole, so the formerly red `the_refusal_names_a_fitting_catalog_entry` is green on the merged tree) |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_library` | not run on the runner; green on the author's local run at this head (15/15) |

No local build was made by this review (runner path; no build slot).

## Heavy lanes

The diff touches `camcraft-app`, so it reaches the 199 app heavy lanes (author's dry-run, named in the body). None ran on the author's head or in this review. The coordinator recorded the decision on this PR: not run, covered by the cut gate, because the change moves only the tool name in a refusal hint, not a toolpath, a check or posted output. Noted, not blocking, per that decision.

## Requested before merge

Nothing.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The runner did not exercise `tool_library`; its green rests on the author's run at this head.
- A follow-up idea, no issue owed: `catalog_suggestion`'s doc comment could say "lower bytewise name" once, to fix the tie-break's meaning in prose.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
